findings.title: A supplier's directory usual price or an ex-works price counts as a firm FOB quote on the match board
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/matchmaking.py:270-272 — any offer with fob_price_usd_per_mt gets basis "quoted"; supply_first.py stores the directory's usual price (source directory_usual_price) and manual_suppliers converts an EXW price without adding the road to the port
findings.fix: Give SupplierOffer a price basis (quoted / usual / estimate, FOB / EXW); only a written quote is "quoted"; EXW gets the inland leg (as the standby list already does) before any margin; a usual price makes the pair an estimate until the RFQ reply
findings.why_money: no deal is confirmed on a margin that disappears when the supplier quotes for real
findings.impact: CONFIRM_MATCH can be proposed on a price the supplier never confirmed in writing, and an ex-works price looks FOB-cheap by the inland cost (USD 15-30/MT on a 350 km haul) — margin shown higher than real

findings.title: Hand-made and supply-first deals never get the deal-created checks
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/continuations.py:712 — on_deal_created only acts on DEAL_CREATED with status MATCHING; a deal created without an opportunity starts DRAFT (services/deals/service.py:529) and later moves to MATCHING by PATCH /deals/{id}/status or supply_first.start, which never emits it again
findings.fix: Run the deal-created leg (enrichment, compliance.check_trade, outreach, RFQ) on every move into MATCHING — or emit DEAL_CREATED with status MATCHING from update_status / supply_first
findings.why_money: a prohibited product or an embargoed buyer is stopped before PortLess spends on outreach — or ships it
findings.impact: no trade-compliance check (HS export policy, embargoed destination), no counterparty enrichment / screening and no RFQ gate for a deal an operator makes by hand or starts from a supplier — outreach starts anyway

findings.title: The audit log can lose entries when two instances write at the same time
findings.evidence: shared/audit_log.py:29 asyncio.Lock is per process; :86 insert_one({"_id": seq}) — two instances computing the same seq → DuplicateKeyError → entry logged as NOT recorded and dropped
findings.fix: On DuplicateKeyError re-read the last entry and retry (bounded); and raise a deal.exception / Telegram alert when an audit write finally fails
findings.why_money: the audit trail a bank, auditor or the escrow provider asks for stays complete
findings.impact: a money approval or a Kill Switch toggle can be missing from the tamper-evident trail exactly when several instances run

findings.title: One operator alone can clear a possible sanctions match
findings.evidence: services/trade_min/screening_review.py:57 resolve() — a single staff decision turns sanctions "review" into "clear" (verified, contactable)
findings.fix: Clearing a review needs two different staff (like four-eyes money gates); failing needs one; both stay in the audit log
findings.why_money: one sanctions breach can freeze the escrow, the bank account and the company
findings.impact: a true sanctions hit cleared by mistake (or by one compromised account) makes a listed company a buyer or supplier

findings.title: A stalled watcher is only reported in the next morning's digest
findings.evidence: shared/heartbeat.py marks a watcher stale; only shared/orchestration/digest.py reports it (daily at DIGEST_HOUR_UTC); shared/leader_lock.py fails closed when Mongo is unreachable, so every instance skips its ticks
findings.fix: Push a Telegram alert the moment a watcher goes stale (checked by every instance, sent once per stale period) and when the leader lock store cannot be reached
findings.why_money: a stuck shipment or a supplier waiting for its money is caught in minutes, not a day
findings.impact: for up to a day no reminders, no QC / freight polling, no lapsed-window auto-release and no approval timeouts — and nobody is told

findings.title: Fees recorded from statements never reach the ledger, the journal or the realised margin
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/fee_check.py keeps recorded fees in collection deal_fees; services/escrow_guard/service.py realised margin and journal.py use fees_total = provider fee % × released and portless_costs only
findings.fix: Feed recorded actual fees into the ledger (fees_total = actual when recorded) and post them to the journal (provider_fees / bank charges); realised margin then follows
findings.why_money: the margin per corridor that pricing learns from is the real one
findings.impact: bank charges and fees above the quote are reported in the digest but the deal's realised margin and the books still show the estimate

findings.title: A supplier on the do-not-contact list still gets RFQs, reconfirmations and best-and-final e-mails
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/continuations.py _rfq_candidates / _hand_added_suppliers (no do_not_contact filter; only _traded_suppliers_first checks it); services/trade_min/relationships.py:297 blocked_contacts reads buyers only
findings.fix: Apply the directory's do-not-contact and declined lists to every supplier e-mail path (RFQ dispatch, quote_reconfirm, best_and_final, send retries)
findings.why_money: the mailbox's reputation is what makes every introduction land
findings.impact: a supplier that asked not to be written to is e-mailed again — complaints, spam reports against the trade-desk domain

findings.title: Five money and risk switches are built but left off, waiting for a decision
findings.evidence: OUTREACH_VERIFIED_ONLY, RFQ_VERIFIED_ONLY (outreach.py, continuations.py), ESCROW_PROVIDER_BY_COST (escrow_guard/service.py), PROSPECT_CLEANUP_ENABLED (prospect_cleanup.py), SUPPLY_FIRST / manual suppliers without a buyer-side check — all default off or permissive
findings.fix: Decide each switch with a recommended setting (verified-only outreach / RFQ on once Apify screening is live; cheapest escrow when both providers are live; clean-up at 60 days) and set it in the deployed environment
findings.why_money: each switch either saves fees or keeps unverified counterparties out of the money path
findings.impact: the protections and savings exist in code but do nothing until someone decides; nobody owns that decision today

findings.title: The public rate limit trusts X-Forwarded-For, so it can be bypassed
findings.evidence: shared/auth/middleware.py:90 — client = first value of X-Forwarded-For, which any caller can set
findings.fix: Use the address the trusted proxy appended (the last hop, or a TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS setting) and fall back to request.client; never the caller-supplied first value
findings.why_money: the anonymous money doors stay protected against brute force and floods
findings.impact: a caller rotating the header gets unlimited attempts at the webhook, unsubscribe and proof-link doors

findings.title: Each module opens its own Mongo client and connection pool
findings.evidence: 29 modules call motor AsyncIOMotorClient(settings.mongo_uri) (e.g. shared/audit_log.py, heartbeat.py, leader_lock.py, fee_check.py, outcomes.py, pricebook.py)
findings.fix: One shared client per process (shared/mongo.py get_client()), every module takes its collection from it
findings.why_money: a smaller Atlas tier carries the load and the backend does not fall over under a scan
findings.impact: up to 29 pools × maxPoolSize connections per instance — Atlas connection limits are hit early on small tiers and serverless cold starts slow down

findings.title: New back-office features have no console screen
findings.evidence: no calls in ../portless-ui/src/api/endpoints.ts for GET /hitl-approval/audit(/verify), POST/GET /escrow-guard/deals/{id}/fees and /fees/over, GET /health/watchers, GET /deals/price-alerts, GET/POST /deals/prospects/cleanup, the journal ?format=tally|zoho
findings.fix: Audit log + verify on System Health, watchers status there too, a fees form and list on the deal's Payments tab and Money & Margin, price alerts on the radar, clean-up preview on Prospects, Tally / Zoho download buttons
findings.why_money: the controls that protect margin are used every day instead of forgotten
findings.impact: staff can only use them through the API docs; fees go unrecorded, stale watchers and price moves are only seen in the digest

findings.title: Supplier e-mails have no unsubscribe and no clear opt-out
findings.evidence: shared/orchestration/unsubscribe.py is used by outreach.draft only; services/sourcing/service.py rfq_email_body, quote_reconfirm.body and best_and_final.body carry none
findings.fix: Add the signed unsubscribe link (supplier role) to RFQ, reconfirmation and best-and-final e-mails, honoured as supplier do-not-contact
findings.why_money: fewer spam reports against the domain that carries every quote request
findings.impact: suppliers (often small mills) have no easy way to stop PortLess's e-mails; under cold-e-mail rules every commercial e-mail should carry one

findings.title: Directory-wide scans on every request will not scale
findings.evidence: 16 places read the whole directory (limit=100_000 / 5000): manual_suppliers.find_duplicate per added row, dedupe.duplicates, supply_first.buyers_for, offer_checks._directory_record, supplier_commitment._manual_standbys, outreach._directory_view (with relationships.annotate)
findings.fix: Indexed lookups (gstin, domain, phone, hs_codes) in the Mongo directory and an index map per import; cache the annotated directory view per minute
findings.why_money: the directory can grow to the size that finds more buyers without slowing the desk
findings.impact: a CSV import of 500 rows over a 10,000-company directory reads 5 million records; the desk and outreach slow down as the directory grows

findings.title: Decisions are typed into browser prompt boxes
findings.evidence: window.prompt in Prospects.tsx (park / drop / retry), BuyersSuppliers.tsx (bulk), CompanyViews.tsx (do-not-contact, start a prospect), ScreeningReviewCard.tsx (clear / fail) — 9 places
findings.fix: One small reason dialog component (reason, optional date / market, the consequence spelled out) used everywhere
findings.why_money: faster, better-documented decisions on the go
findings.impact: no validation, no context while typing a reason, unusable on a phone; reasons end up as one word
